proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3949 *gakṣa gives Nepali gāch and Bhojpuri gā̃ch tree. Danuwar gats/gãts fits the regional affricated tree family; deaspiration and the nasal variant are retained. Exact survey form gãts is preserved.
